scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:functions && npm run typecheck --workspace=client && npm run typecheck --workspace=server
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build:functions
scripts.build:functions: wrangler pages functions build functions --outdir .wrangler/functions --project-directory . --build-output-directory client/dist
scripts.dev:cloudflare: npm run build:cloudflare && wrangler pages dev --config wrangler.pages.jsonc
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run build:cloudflare && wrangler pages deploy --config wrangler.pages.jsonc --commit-dirty=true
scripts.lint: npm run lint:functions && npm run lint --workspace=client && npm run lint --workspace=server
